Targeted pass of a 764-page BREF. Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 34). Data are EU (plant examples UK, FR, SE, NL, IT, FI). Loaded: MSWI capex by FGC type and size (Table 1.9, Germany, price year not stated -> 2019 flagged) and 1999 cost structure (Table 1.10); plant energy demand per t waste by waste type (Table 3.37) and HW electricity 132-476 kWh/t; HW and sewage-sludge steam parameters and gross electrical efficiency (Tables 3.33-3.36); BAT-AEELs (Table 5.2: gross electrical 25-35 new / 20-35 existing, gross energy 72-91, boiler efficiency HW 60-80, SS 60-70); typical MSW steam conditions, electricity 0.4-0.8 MWh/t and CHP heat 1.25-1.8 MWh/t (flows), export and CHP efficiency ranges, MSW electricity use 60-190 kWh/t; fossil CO2 per t MSW (derived 0.7-1.7 t CO2/t x 33-50 % fossil); performance-test plant examples UK03, FR33, FR18, FR53, Viridor Runcorn (Annex 8.2); Umea and Paris plant balances; emerging techniques steam reheat (AEB Amsterdam) and flameless pressurised oxycombustion (Isotherm). Efficiencies are gross on LHV input unless the note says net. Measures: Table 2.13 steam-cycle improvements, Table 2.12 heat pumps, flue-gas condensation (Table 4.9), heat pumps, vacuum, external superheater (Table 4.10), FGR. Not loaded: pollutant emissions and BAT-AELs, N2O concentrations, water, residues, noise, FGC costs (Tables 4.20, 4.24, 8.8-8.9), monitoring costs, gate fees (Table 1.7) and country cost comparisons (Table 1.8, partly in other-values), and Figures 3.87-3.92 (per-plant efficiency bar charts with no printed values). Whole-plant per-t rows use technology names boiler_solid-fuel_msw* and are proposed as a NEW archetype; energy-basis rows map to steam-turbine_condensing / steam-turbine_back-pressure / boiler_solid-fuel.
